body:
<forge-entity title="Luke Glendening" slug="luke-glendening-8476822" code="player">Luke Glendening</forge-entity> signed a one-year, $850,000 contract with the New York Rangers on Thursday.

The 37-year-old forward split last season between the New Jersey Devils and Philadelphia Flyers, putting up nine points (two goals, seven assists) in 70 games.

Signed by the Detroit Red Wings as an undrafted free agent on July 5, 2013, Glendening has 175 points (85 goals, 90 assists) in 934 regular-season games for the Red Wings, Dallas Stars, Tampa Bay Lightning, Devils and Flyers. He also has 11 points (seven goals, four assists) in 60 Stanley Cup Playoff games.

Since the start of the 2020-21 season, Glendening has won 57.5 percent of his face-offs, which is ninth in the NHL (minimum 1,000 draws).
